name: whereami
description: Shows at a glance whether this session runs on your own machine or in a cloud container, and moves a cloud session back to your machine with /go-local

workspaceRoot.title: Local folder for repositories
workspaceRoot.description: Where /go-local looks for (or clones) a repository on your machine when it isn't listed below: <folder>/<repository name>. Written for a shell, so $HOME works.

workspaces.title: Local checkouts
workspaces.description: owner/repo=folder pairs, separated by commas, for repositories kept elsewhere. Example: acme/shop=$HOME/work/shop
